status: Modwerk's Digitakt II base for OS 1.17, built from the pinned core-dt2 1.1 source and selected by the SHA-256 in sdk/machines/digitakt-ii/base-binding.json.

events.name: ev_tick
events.when: the UI compose check, approximately 30 Hz
events.handler: void f(void *ctrl); set ctrl + 0x20 to 1 to request redraw; not an audio-rate clock

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS composes the 128x64 screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_frame_params
events.when: once a frame, in the frame interrupt, before the stock modulators add their values
events.handler: void f(int16_t *values, int stride); track t's value j at values[stride * t + j], stride 71; add to it, held in the parameter's range; the kit and the pages are untouched
events.order: lower order first (shipped mods use 10-90); every handler sees the values the earlier ones left

events.name: ev_key_leds
events.when: every UI frame, after the frame clears the key LEDs and before the stock views set theirs (UI task)
events.handler: void f(void *mgr); set an LED with fw_led_set(mgr, logical, 2, value); the first setter of an LED wins, so a handler's LED stays over the stock view's
events.order: lower order first (shipped mods use 10-90); the first handler to set an LED keeps it

events.name: ev_seq_audio_phrase
events.when: On supported audio note trigs after pitch resolution, and on later empty steps when requested. Subscribers are visited in ascending contribution order.
events.handler: uint32_t handler(const struct dt2_seq_grid_window *window, uint32_t pitch, uint32_t velocity, struct dt2_seq_phrase_note *notes); write at most eight notes to notes and return their count. Zero passes through or ends continuation. REST is silent. OR CARRY into the count to request empty steps. Use the read-only stock deadlines, keep work bounded, and leave the stock queue untouched.

events.name: ev_seq_note
events.when: After the OS constructs a supported audio note, on PLAY and subsequent steps, before the note enters the stock queue.
events.handler: int32_t handler(const struct dt2_seq_note_context *context, uint32_t pitch); return a pitch from 0 through 127, or leave the current pitch unchanged with an out-of-range result. The context is read-only.
events.order: Four slots, in ascending contribution order. Each callback sees the previous accepted pitch.

events.name: ev_audio_frame
events.when: on the ColdFire audio frame path, immediately before the stock DSP transfer
events.handler: void f(unsigned int data_bytes, const void *data, unsigned int frame_bytes, const void *reply)
events.order: lower subscription order first; linker breaks ties by module ID and contribution order
events.purpose: The arguments are the original stock transfer arguments and are borrowed for this call. A subscriber may update its own preallocated state and its explicitly reserved DSP frame-tail data words only. Preserve stock data, command words and reply storage. Do not allocate, block or retain the pointers.

tables.name: core_fast
tables.purpose: Copy-table entries used to move linked .fast code into the Digitakt II SRAM tail on the first UI tick.

tables.name: core_projdata
tables.purpose: Pointers to core_projdata_t descriptors {tag[4], size, data, loaded}: each mod's block in the project file's header gap (+0x1c to +0x200), saved with every project save and loaded back. Reader: core's store (project save and load sites). A mod claims projdata:<tag>.

tables.name: core_kitdata
tables.purpose: Pointers to core_kitdata_t descriptors {tag[4], size, data, changed}: each mod's block per kit (128 kits), after each kit record's end mark, saved with the project and SAVE KIT, loaded back and copied with the firmware's kit copies. All mods share 143 bytes a kit record (core_kitdata_room()); the record's last 48 bytes hold the base's project archive; a block that does not fit is left out. Reader: core's store. A mod claims kitdata:<tag>.

sites.role: memcpy: follows kit copies in RAM (pattern copy and paste, PASTE KIT, undo)

tables.name: core_project_archive
tables.purpose: Pointers to fixed-size project save/load descriptors.

tables.name: core_mixer_pages
tables.purpose: Null-terminated pointers to dt2_mixer_extension descriptors, each holding a native page descriptor and void draw(void *view, void *bitmap). The UI reads the table when constructing the Mixer page list and dispatches draw for the active registered page. Lower contribution order first, ties by module ID and contribution order. The renderer may draw into its own page bitmap and update module-owned state; the view is borrowed and stock navigation and page state are read-only.

tables.name: core_machines
tables.purpose: Null-terminated pointers to struct dt2_machine records (mk2/machines.h): track machines added after the seven stock types, each with its own machine type 7-10 (claimed as machine:<type>, saved with kits), the stock type it stands for, its names and its five knob names on the stand-in's parameters. The base lists them in the machine menu, keeps them through kit load, shows their knob names while a page shows that machine and, when the module's package carries a build.sharc player, sends their voices to it on the sound chip through that type's registry slot; without one they play as the stock type they stand for.

exports.name: core_project_archive
exports.prototype: Contribute a pointer to a const dt2_project_archive_t with a unique tag, four-byte-aligned size, save(void *data), and load(const void *data).
exports.purpose: Runs on full active-project save and load, in ascending contribution order. The archive shares 5632 bytes including its eight-byte header and eight bytes per block. A contribution may write only its own save block and read only its own load block. Load receives null for missing data or a new project. Oversized contributions are skipped and counted as conflicts.

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a SETTINGS or PERSONALIZE row from the corresponding event handler.

exports.name: core_addvalue
exports.purpose: Add a PERSONALIZE or SETTINGS row that shows a label and, on the right as LED INTENSITY does, values[get()]; from ev_personalize or ev_settings.

exports.name: core_kit_on
exports.purpose: The kit on (the pattern on's), -1 for none.

exports.name: core_kitdata_room
exports.purpose: Bytes a kit record holds for the mods' blocks (143).

exports.name: core_machine_view_track
exports.purpose: The track (0-15, or DT2_MACHINE_VIEW_NONE) whose voice the machine players on the sound chip post in core_machine_view. A module's page sets it from the UI task while it shows that track; the base sends it with every transfer.

exports.name: core_machine_view
exports.purpose: 32 words a machine player posted about the view track's voice, as of the last transfer's reply. Read-only. The player's own magic first, then the track the words describe; anything else is the player's. A view naming another track, or another magic, is not this module's.

exports.name: core_machine_sample_views
exports.purpose: Counts the SRC page's sample view as it draws: it changes in every frame composed while the second page shows and in no other, so an ev_draw handler that sees it changed since its last call may draw over the sample view of the current track. Read-only.

exports.name: core_store_conflicts
exports.purpose: How many times a save or a load met bytes in the mods' areas that are not core's; core left them as they were.

exports.name: fw_*
exports.prototype: digitakt-mk2/core.h: fw_led_set. mk2/core.h: Modwerk's drawing and view bindings.
exports.purpose: Firmware locations for the LED frame and module pages. Track selection uses fw_pattern_ui (0x44f370a0), fw_track_at (0x4004abb8), and fw_select_track (0x40077308). Use these from the UI task. Build preflight rejects the raw +Drive block write.
